# API

Local server only; there is no login.

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /` | web app |
| `GET /sw.js` | offline app shell |
| `GET /api/overview` | forecasts, upcoming meetings, changes |
| `GET /api/stock/{iid}` | prices, forecasts, track record, meetings, filings |
| `GET /api/filings` | search filings (`q`, `category`, `instrument`, `limit`) |
| `GET /api/filings/categories` | most common filing categories |
| `GET /api/portfolio` | risk of a mix (`holdings=NSE:INFY:50000,...`, `horizon`) |
| `GET /api/backup` | zip of the forward ledgers |
| `GET /api/model` | progress, reliability, rejected ideas |
| `GET /api/system` | health, audit, ledgers, forward scorecard |
| `POST /api/refresh` | start the daily refresh (app only) |
| `GET /api/refresh` | refresh state |
| `POST /v3/analyse` | direction signal or abstention |
| `POST /v3/evidence` | point-in-time filing evidence (opt-in) |
| `POST /v3/explain` | guarded answer from filings (opt-in) |
| `POST /v3/classify` | filing event type (opt-in) |
| `GET /v3/volatility` | volatility forecast for one stock |
| `GET /v3/health` | serving state |
| `POST /v3/admin/kill` | trip the kill switch (token) |
| `POST /v3/admin/reset` | reset it (token) |
| `GET /v3/audit/verify` | check the audit hash chain |
| `POST /v3/audit/replay/{seq}` | recompute a logged signal |
| `GET /v3/dashboard` | server-rendered monitoring page |
